privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Marlow LoL is operated by Mobi Media, Inc. This policy explains how we handle information when you use the Marlow LoL app, our web app, and this informational website. Contact marlow.app@gmail.com with privacy questions or requests.

sections.title: Information you provide
paragraphs: Account information may include your username, a password hash when you choose password sign-in, and an Apple or Google account identifier and email address when you use those sign-in options. We do not receive your Apple or Google password.

Profile information includes your first name, last initial, date of birth for age eligibility, profile photo if you add one, and other profile fields you choose to complete, such as school. The service is intended for people age 18 and older.

sections.title: Information from using the app
paragraphs: We store Circle names, membership, connections, invitations and approval preferences; question rounds, picks and skips; profile results and activity needed to calculate and display them; and reports, blocks and notifications.

We store session tokens in hashed form and related timestamps to keep you signed in and protect account access. If you enable push notifications, we store your device's push token and notification preferences. Our hosting and delivery providers may process request information such as IP addresses, browser or device information, timestamps and error logs to deliver and secure the service.

sections.title: How we use information
paragraphs: We use this information to authenticate accounts, apply age restrictions, display profiles, run Circles and invitation flows, deliver rounds and results, send requested notifications, respond to support requests, investigate reports and abuse, and maintain and secure the service.

sections.title: What other people can see
paragraphs: Profile details and photos are shown in relevant social features, including Circles and candidate selections. Circle members can see information needed to participate in their shared Circle. Results may show questions, pick counts and aggregated profile traits. Do not treat picks as confidential communications: the service stores individual voting records to operate the game, even when a view does not identify the voter.

People you send an invitation to receive a link that can grant access according to the Circle's invitation settings. Share links only with intended recipients. Content you choose to share using your device's share sheet is handled by the destination service you select.

sections.title: Service providers and disclosures
paragraphs: We use providers for hosting, database and file storage, sign-in, app distribution, app updates and push delivery. Current integrations include Railway, Apple, Google and Expo. They process information needed to provide their respective services under their own terms and privacy policies. We may disclose information when required by law, to protect rights and safety, to address fraud or abuse, or as part of a business transfer subject to appropriate protections.
We do not sell personal information. The current app does not include third-party advertising or an advertising-tracking SDK.

sections.title: Permissions and invitations
paragraphs: You can decline or later disable push notifications in device settings. Camera and photo access are used when you choose to add a profile photo. Invitations use your device's sharing tools; Marlow does not require an address-book upload or a phone number.

sections.title: Retention and account requests
paragraphs: We retain information as needed to operate the service, handle safety reports and disputes, meet legal obligations, and maintain backups. Retention varies by data type and purpose; we do not promise an immediate purge of every backup.

You can request account deletion in Settings or contact marlow.app@gmail.com for access, correction or deletion assistance. The current beta's in-app deletion control disables the account; it does not by itself erase all associated records. Email us for a request concerning remaining personal data. We may need to verify your account ownership before acting. We will explain any information that must be retained and why.

sections.title: Children, security and international processing
paragraphs: Marlow LoL is not intended for anyone under 18. If you believe an underage person has provided information, contact us. We use access controls and other safeguards to protect information, but no service can guarantee absolute security. Our providers may process information in countries other than your own.

sections.title: This website
paragraphs: The informational pages are hosted on GitHub Pages. They do not use advertising cookies, a contact form or embedded analytics. GitHub may process technical request information to deliver and secure the website. Opening the app, TestFlight or an email link takes you to the respective service. Your browser may cache the site's assets.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy as the service changes. The date on this page identifies the latest revision. For privacy questions or requests, contact Mobi Media, Inc. at marlow.app@gmail.com. Include your username and a description of your request, but do not send your password, sign-in codes or private keys.

support.title: We're here to help.
support.intro: Contact Mobi Media, Inc., the team behind Marlow LoL, at marlow.app@gmail.com for account, invitation, Circle, privacy and safety support.

sections.title: Contact support
paragraphs: Email marlow.app@gmail.com. Include your username, your iPhone model, iOS version, app version or build number, and a description of what happened. A screenshot can help; hide other people's private information first. Never send passwords, verification codes or private keys.

sections.title: Installing the beta
paragraphs: Marlow LoL is currently available through external TestFlight testing. Install Apple's TestFlight app, open the Marlow beta link and choose Install. An invitation to a Circle is separate from a TestFlight invitation. After installing Marlow, reopen the original Circle invitation to join the intended group.

sections.title: Joining a Circle
paragraphs: Open the invitation from someone you know, then sign in or create an account. A Circle may require approval before you can join. If the link is expired or no longer works, ask the person who invited you for a new one. Existing Railway-hosted invitation links remain supported.

sections.title: Starting your first round
paragraphs: Add at least two people you know before starting a round. Create or join a Circle and invite your people. Once they have joined and your connections are available, return to Play and try again.

sections.title: App updates
paragraphs: Some improvements arrive automatically when you reopen the app. Changes that require a new native version must be installed through TestFlight or, after public launch, the App Store. If something looks outdated, close and reopen Marlow and check TestFlight for a newer build.

sections.title: Report a safety concern
paragraphs: Use the app's report and block controls for unwanted interactions. You can also email marlow.app@gmail.com with the relevant username, Circle and details. Avoid sending unnecessary sensitive information. Marlow support is not an emergency service; contact local emergency services if someone is in immediate danger.

sections.title: Account and privacy requests
paragraphs: Use Settings for account controls, privacy information and the beta account-deletion option. That control currently disables the account rather than erasing all associated records. For a personal-data deletion request, a correction, or help accessing your account, email marlow.app@gmail.com. We may ask you to verify account ownership.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms describe use of Marlow LoL, operated by Mobi Media, Inc. Questions can be sent to marlow.app@gmail.com.

sections.title: Eligibility and accounts
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 to use Marlow LoL. Provide accurate information, protect your login credentials and use an account you are authorized to access. You are responsible for activity under your account.

sections.title: Keep it kind
paragraphs: Do not harass, threaten, impersonate, exploit or discriminate against others; upload unlawful content; share someone's private information without permission; send spam; or bypass safety or access controls. Use invitations only with intended recipients. Report and block unwanted interactions.

sections.title: Profiles, Circles and picks
paragraphs: Only upload content you have the right to share. You allow us to store, process and display that content as needed to provide the service. Questions are curated. Picks and profile traits reflect people's participation in a social game and are not factual assessments, professional advice or a measure of personal worth.

sections.title: Beta service and safety
paragraphs: The service is in beta and may contain errors or change over time. Features and availability may change. We may remove content or restrict accounts that violate these terms or threaten the service or other people. Contact support if you believe a restriction was applied in error.

sections.title: Privacy and leaving the service
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy describes the information we process and your options. You can stop using the service at any time. Use Settings for account controls or email marlow.app@gmail.com for account and personal-data requests. The beta deletion control currently disables the account and does not erase every associated record.

sections.title: Contact and updates
paragraphs: We may update these terms as the service changes. The revision date is shown on this page. Contact Mobi Media, Inc. at marlow.app@gmail.com for questions about these terms or support.
